title: AND/OR precedence in a session filter
description: Fix the query. Return only production sessions whose state is either active or idle in transaction. A session from another environment must never pass for either state. Return exactly three columns: session_id, environment, state. Sort by session_id ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT session_id, environment, state
FROM sessions
WHERE environment = 'production' AND state = 'active' OR state = 'idle in transaction'
ORDER BY session_id ASC;
hints: AND has higher precedence than OR.
Group the two accepted states into one logical condition.
solution_explanation: Parentheses make environment = production apply to both state alternatives.
